[PATH:theoretical] Theoretical analysis of gradient alignment between biologically plausible plasticity rules and meta-learning objectives (e.g., MAML, Reptile) in low-data regimes — A formal derivation of whether Hebbian/STDP updates approximate or conflict with gradient-based meta-learning updates can explain observed transfer performance limitations and predict conditions under which hindrance occurs.
